title: Environments as Scaffold: Enriching Feedback to Bootstrap Self-Evolving Agents in Long-Horizon Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2609.08404v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models demonstrate remarkable proficiency in static reasoning, yet training them as autonomous agents through Reinforcement Learning (RL) for long-horizon tasks is often hindered by severe reward sparsity. While conventional \textit{agent-side warming} up via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can alleviate this, it is frequently limited by data scarcity and constrained exploration. To address this, we propose a paradigm shift to \textit{environment-side adaptation} by constructing \textbf{F}eedback-\textbf{E}nriched \textbf{E}nvironments (\textbf{FEEs}). Through a pilot study, we establish a feedback design strategy that reformulates environments by transitioning from action guidance to observation enrichment during the later stages of both intra-episode exploration and inter-episode evolution. Large-scale experiments on SciWorld and BFCL benchmarks using various Qwen3 model scales and RL algorithms such as GRPO, GSPO, and DA

translated_title: 环境作为脚手架：通过丰富反馈引导长程任务中的自进化智能体
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在静态推理方面展现出卓越能力，但通过强化学习（RL）将其训练为能够完成长程任务的自主智能体时，往往受到严重的奖励稀疏性问题的阻碍。虽然传统的通过监督微调（SFT）进行“智能体侧预热”可以缓解这一问题，但通常受限于数据稀缺和探索能力受限。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种向“环境侧适应”的范式转变，即构建反馈丰富环境（Feedback-Enriched Environments, FEEs）。通过试点研究，我们确立了一种反馈设计策略：在片段内探索和片段间演化的后期阶段，将环境反馈从动作引导转变为观察丰富。我们在SciWorld和BFCL基准上，使用多种规模的Qwen3模型以及GRPO、GSPO、DA等强化学习算法开展了大规模实验。
tldr: 提出反馈丰富环境（FEEs）这一环境侧适应新范式，通过在探索和演化的后期阶段将反馈从动作引导转向观察丰富，有效缓解了强化学习训练自进化智能体在长程任务中的奖励稀疏问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Feedback-Enriched Environments (FEEs), a paradigm shift toward environment-side adaptation that bootstraps self-evolving agents in long-horizon RL tasks by transitioning feedback from action guidance to observation enrichment in later stages of exploration and evolution, alleviating severe reward sparsity.
